purpose: Packaged Electron open-in-place, mediated read/write and process-restart persistence on a disposable existing vault.
assertions: opening an existing directory reports an unchanged scan
read bytes and revisions come from the selected vault
writes require the read revision and survive a fresh process
vault files remain outside Electron user-data storage
a --vault/--open launch intent hydrates the visible editor
keyboard save persists Unicode input through the revision-aware broker
source and live-preview mode controls switch without changing source bytes
external_pending: reference Obsidian reopen and back-to-back portability
